question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Benevolent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Benevolent"** means showing kindness or goodwill; it refers to someone who is well-meaning and charitable. (दयालु)

 
 
• **Example: **The benevolent old man donated a significant portion of his wealth to charity.
 
 
 
• **"Cruel" **refers to someone who causes pain or suffering to others, either physically or emotionally; it is the opposite of being kind or benevolent. (क्रूर)
 
 
• **Example: **The cruel dictator showed no mercy towards his opponents.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'benevolent' **is **'cruel'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Happy **(खुश): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

 
 
• **Example:** She was very happy to receive the news of her promotion.
 
 
 
• **Patient **(धैर्यवान ): Able to accept or tolerate delays, problems, or suffering without becoming annoyed or anxious.
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher was very patient with the slow learners in the class.
 
 
 
• **Harmless** (निर्दोष): Not likely to cause harm or injury.
 
 
• **Example:** The small, harmless snake slithered away into the bushes.
